The vendor directly providing the software product at **overlap.ai** is **Vastly, Inc.**.

### Supporting Evidence
On the official **overlap.ai** website (including its Contact page and website-wide footers), the provider states:
> *"Mailing address. Vastly, Inc. 651 North Broad Street Suite 201 Middletown, DE 19709 United States. These are the addresses published in our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. The Terms also give a postal contact for questions about them: Overlap (Vastly, Inc.), 78 S Park, San Francisco, CA."*

The site pages and legal notices are copyrighted under **© Vastly, Inc.**.
